sub_graphs.title: Deneb Polynomial Commitments: Blob-to-Commitment Pipeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the process of converting raw blob data into KZG commitments and generating proofs for data availability verification

nodes.label: Raw Blob Data Available
nodes.description: 131,072 bytes of raw blob data (4096 field elements) ready for commitment

nodes.label: Parse Blob to Field Elements
nodes.description: Split blob into 4096 32-byte field elements and validate each is less than BLS_MODULUS

nodes.label: Compute KZG Commitment
nodes.description: Perform linear combination of Lagrange basis G1 points weighted by field elements to produce a 48-byte commitment

nodes.label: KZG Commitment Generated
nodes.description: A 48-byte compressed G1 point representing the polynomial commitment to the blob data

nodes.label: Compute KZG Proof
nodes.description: Compute the quotient polynomial q(x) = (p(x) - p(z)) / (x - z) and evaluate as a G1 point for the proof

nodes.label: KZG Proof Generated
nodes.description: A 48-byte proof that can be used to verify evaluations of the committed polynomial

external_entities.name: Blob Data Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity providing raw blob data for KZG commitment generation

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Polynomial Commitments: KZG Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the verification of KZG proofs including single and batch verification using pairing checks

nodes.label: KZG Proof Received for Verification
nodes.description: A KZG commitment, evaluation point, claimed value, and proof have been received

nodes.label: Validate Commitment and Proof Points
nodes.description: Perform KeyValidate check per BLS standards on commitment and proof G1 points; identity point (0xc0...) is permitted

nodes.label: Execute Pairing Check
nodes.description: Verify P - y·G1 = Q · (X - z·G2) using bilinear pairing on BLS12-381

nodes.label: KZG Proof Valid
nodes.description: The pairing check confirms the claimed evaluation is correct for the committed polynomial

nodes.label: KZG Proof Invalid
nodes.description: The pairing check failed, evaluation claim is rejected

external_entities.name: Proof Provider
external_entities.description: External entity submitting KZG proofs for verification (block proposer or peer)

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Polynomial Commitments: Batch Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the efficient batch verification of multiple KZG proofs using random linear combinations for computational efficiency

nodes.label: Multiple KZG Proofs Pending Verification
nodes.description: A batch of KZG commitments, evaluation points, values, and proofs awaiting batch verification

nodes.label: Generate Fiat-Shamir Random Challenges
nodes.description: Derive random scalar challenges using domain-separated Fiat-Shamir (RCKZGBATCH___V1_) from all proof inputs

nodes.label: Combine Proofs with Random Weights
nodes.description: Compute random linear combination of all proofs and commitments using the generated challenges

nodes.label: Execute Single Batched Pairing Check
nodes.description: Perform one pairing check that verifies all proofs simultaneously

nodes.label: All Proofs in Batch Valid
nodes.description: The batched pairing check confirms all proofs are valid

nodes.label: Batch Verification Failed
nodes.description: At least one proof in the batch is invalid

sub_graphs.title: Deneb Polynomial Commitments: Blob-Specific Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the blob-specific proof verification that deterministically derives evaluation challenges from blob and commitment data

nodes.label: Blob and Commitment Received
nodes.description: A blob, its KZG commitment, and proof are available for blob-specific verification

nodes.label: Compute Blob Evaluation Challenge
nodes.description: Deterministically derive evaluation point z from blob and commitment using Fiat-Shamir with FSBLOBVERIFY_V1_ domain

nodes.label: Evaluate Polynomial at Challenge Point
nodes.description: Evaluate the blob's polynomial at the challenge point z using barycentric interpolation over roots of unity

nodes.label: Verify Blob KZG Proof
nodes.description: Verify the KZG proof for the evaluated point using pairing check

nodes.label: Blob Data Verified Against Commitment
nodes.description: The blob data matches the KZG commitment, confirming data availability

nodes.label: Blob Verification Failed
nodes.description: The blob data does not match the commitment

edges.label: Receive blob, commitment, and proof for verification

external_entities.name: Blob Data Source
external_entities.description: Network peer or local storage providing blob data alongside its commitment and proof for verification

ambiguities.text: The identity point (0xc0 followed by 47 zero bytes) is 'explicitly permitted' in KeyValidate but the security implications for commitment schemes accepting identity commitments are not discussed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume identity point commitments represent the zero polynomial (all-zero blob). This is a valid edge case but implementations should be aware that it commits to no meaningful data.

ambiguities.text: The specification describes the quotient polynomial computation 'handling the special case where evaluation points are roots of unity' without fully specifying the edge case behavior.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the implementation uses L'Hôpital's rule or direct substitution when the evaluation point coincides with a root of unity, computing the derivative of numerator and denominator.

ambiguities.text: The term 'bit-reversal permutation' is used without defining the exact algorithm for the 4096-element domain.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard 12-bit reversal (log2(4096) = 12) where each index i is mapped to the index formed by reversing its 12-bit binary representation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG trusted setup parameters (G1 and G2 points) are correctly generated and the discrete logarithm relationships between them are as specified.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Broken trusted setup would allow forgery of KZG proofs, completely compromising data availability guarantees and enabling invalid blob acceptance.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot solve the discrete logarithm problem on BLS12-381, which underpins the binding property of KZG commitments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could create two different blobs that produce the same commitment, enabling data substitution attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: All field elements in blobs are strictly less than BLS_MODULUS and implementations correctly reject oversized elements.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Field element overflow could cause inconsistent polynomial evaluations across implementations, leading to consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Fiat-Shamir domain separation tags (FSBLOBVERIFY_V1_ and RCKZGBATCH___V1_) prevent cross-protocol challenge reuse.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without proper domain separation, an attacker could potentially reuse challenges from one verification context in another, compromising soundness.
